You are fixing one constant in a probe harness in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py, check_live_baseline.py and test_live_baseline.py in that folder (and write under bench/results/transcript-1a-dry/). Never edit storygame/, data/, tests/, docs/, .plans/.

CHANGE. In live_baseline.py the ROUTES entry `witnessed` (currently 10 inputs) must become exactly these 11 inputs, in order:
go in the house / examine the carved initials / wait / wait / wait / feel under the drawer / say what the card is to the officer / wait / go out to the truck / get in / look around
(Reason: the patrol officer enters the house only after scene turn 5 completes, so the card must be taken at input 6; a bare 'feel in the gap' would not earn because its one-turn cue referent has expired by then, so the explicit 'feel under the drawer' is used.) Do not change the `reported` or `corrected` routes. Update any test or checker expectation that hard-codes the witnessed length of 10 (grep for it) to 11, deriving it from ROUTES where possible.
FINISH: ruff format and ruff check the three files; run the tests; run `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py --dry-run --route witnessed --replicates 1 --out bench/results/transcript-1a-dry/witnessed` and the checker with --mode dry; then print, for that dry run, for each turn the input, the selected_knowledge_ids and the memory_card parent, so the report shows that input 6 selects k_sl_1a_b_r0w.
